title: PROFILE_DYNAMICS_BC_THIRD_RAW_TABLE_COHORT_NO_Y
purpose: Generate a 22-candidate Grade B/C batch from already hash-verified SLICE-004 slice and overlay pixel-readback profiles. The batch characterises through-axis distribution shape and pair-to-pair variation without creating a new image, mask, mesh or slice.

candidate_schema.RAW-X038: slice material-area and component-count profile skewness, excess kurtosis, peak-to-mean and range-over-mean
candidate_schema.RAW-X039: red/blue/purple/union overlay count profile lag-1 autocorrelation and normalized total variation
candidate_schema.RAW-X040: red/blue/purple overlay phase-fraction profile population standard deviation and lag-1 autocorrelation
candidate_schema.units: all outputs are dimensionless profile-shape, normalized-variation or correlation measures
candidate_schema.denominator_policy: all verified profiles are nonconstant and all overlay union denominators must be positive; fail rather than impute
